user.title: Add a remote to Universal IR RF Remote Manager
user.description: Choose an existing remote entity from Home Assistant (Broadlink, Tuya Local or another compatible provider). No additional hub connection is created.

error.remote_missing: Choose an existing Home Assistant remote entity.
error.already_configured: This remote is already managed by another entry.

learn_command.title: Learn an IR/RF command
learn_command.description: Remote: {remote}. Choose IR or RF and tap **Start learning** to start waiting for a signal. IR: press the remote button once when learning starts. Broadlink RF: its firmware requires frequency scan (hold or repeatedly press), then one short press to capture. You cannot skip the RF sweep or manually select 315/433 here. Follow Home Assistant Notifications.

send_command.title: Send IR/RF command
send_command.description: Send a command through this remote. The signal must already be stored by the provider, or be an inline code that provider accepts.

settings.title: Remote and fan management
settings.description: Add, edit or remove a fan linked to a saved virtual appliance. Removing a fan mapping keeps the appliance and its commands.

devices.title: Virtual appliances
devices.description: Manage appliances under this remote. {device_count} devices saved.

create_device.title: Create an appliance
create_device.description: Give this appliance a friendly name. Provider device key is optional and should remain fixed when renamed.

edit_device.title: Edit appliance
edit_device.description: Original provider key: {provider_device}. Renaming only changes the display name, not stored signal codes.

confirm_delete_device.title: Delete appliance?
confirm_delete_device.description: Delete {device} and its {command_count} locally saved command entries? Broadlink/provider codes are retained.

manage_commands.title: Appliance commands
manage_commands.description: Device: {device}. Saved commands: {command_count}. Use Import for existing Broadlink Base64 signals.

edit_command.title: Rename command
edit_command.description: Rename {command} without changing its source Broadlink command or raw code.

confirm_delete_command.title: Delete saved command?
confirm_delete_command.description: Remove {command} from {device}? Original Broadlink provider codes are retained.

import_code.title: Import Broadlink Base64
import_code.description: Choose an appliance, enter a name and paste Base64 code (with or without b64:). This avoids RF learning entirely. Supported for providers accepting raw b64: packets, including Broadlink.

fan_pick.title: Select a saved appliance
fan_pick.description: Remote: {remote}. Action: {action}. Only appliances belonging to this remote are available. Create an appliance and import its commands first.

fan_count.title: Speed levels
fan_count.description: Appliance: {device}. Select how many real command codes to map.

fan_map.title: Map fan commands
fan_map.description: Appliance: {device}. Remote: {remote}. Choose one distinct saved command per speed. Choose an OFF command. If none is chosen, the integration can recognize an existing code named turn_off, off or power_off.

fan_confirm_delete.title: Remove fan entity?
fan_confirm_delete.description: Remove the fan entity for {device}? Saved signals and the virtual appliance will remain.

remote_settings.title: Remote provider settings
remote_settings.description: Select the remote entity. Only choose an RF frequency number.* entity when your hardware provider supports explicit band setting. Broadlink does not need one.

fan_rename.title: Rename fan appliance
fan_rename.description: Rename {device}. This does not alter the physical commands or fan linkage.

error.library_failed: Unable to read/write metadata; existing file was preserved.
error.invalid_name: A valid device and command must be selected.
error.learn_failed: The remote provider could not learn this signal.
error.send_failed: The remote provider could not send this signal.
error.delete_failed: The remote provider refused or does not support deletion.
error.remote_missing: Choose an existing Home Assistant remote entity.
error.already_configured: This remote is managed by another entry.
error.band_not_supported: For Broadlink use RF. Do not choose 315/433 or enter a frequency.
error.no_fan_devices: No suitable appliance. Create an appliance and add commands first, or select an existing configured fan to edit or remove.
error.invalid_fan_commands: Each speed must use a distinct saved command from the selected appliance; OFF must also be different.
error.remote_unavailable: The selected remote is unavailable or missing. Reconnect it and retry.
error.learn_timeout: No signal was captured before the learning timeout. Try remote.learn_command directly and check Logs / Notifications.
error.learn_cancelled: Learning was canceled. The command was not saved.

progress.waiting_ir: Waiting for IR on {remote} for {device} / {command}. **Press the original remote button once**, pointing at the IR receiver. Wait for the learning operation to complete.
progress.waiting_rf: Learning RF on {remote} for {device} / {command}. **Broadlink first needs a frequency sweep**: hold the button (or press repeatedly if it does not transmit continuously); watch its LED / Home Assistant Notifications. Then **press briefly once** to capture the code. This step is required by Broadlink hardware.
